log_file.description: Path to the Hatari log file

frame_skips.description: Frames to skip per rendered frame (0=none; increase to trade smoothness for emulation speed)

vdi_enabled.description: Enable extended VDI resolutions; only usable with ST-High mono mode

vdi_width.description: VDI resolution width in pixels (used when vdi_enabled is true)

vdi_height.description: VDI resolution height in pixels (used when vdi_enabled is true)

max_width.description: Maximum emulator window width in pixels

max_height.description: Maximum emulator window height in pixels

use_vsync.description: Synchronise rendering to the display vertical blank (reduces tearing)

show_status_bar.description: Show the status bar with drive and CPU indicators beneath the emulator screen

disable_key_repeat.description: Suppress host key-repeat events from reaching the emulator

keymap_type.description: Keyboard mapping mode: 0=symbolic (character, layout-independent), 1=scancode (physical key position)

keymap_file.description: Path to a custom keyboard mapping file; leave empty to use the built-in map

sound_enabled.description: Enable YM2149 sound chip emulation and audio output

sound_sync.description: Lock emulation speed to the audio output rate (prevents buffer underruns; may slow emulation)

sound_freq.description: Audio playback sample rate in Hz (common values: 22050, 44100, 48000)

sound_buffer_size.description: SDL audio buffer size in bytes; 0 = let SDL choose automatically

ym_capture_file.description: File path for captured YM audio output

sound_highpass_filter.description: Apply DC-removal high-pass filter to audio output (recommended)

memory_size_mb.description: Base ST/STE RAM in MB: valid values are 1, 2, 4, 8, or 14

tt_ram_size_mb.description: TT/Falcon fast RAM in MB; 0 = disabled; valid values are multiples of 256 up to 1024

memory_auto_save.description: Automatically save a memory snapshot when Hatari exits

memory_snapshot_file.description: File path used for manually triggered memory snapshots

memory_autosave_file.description: File path for the automatic on-exit memory snapshot

floppy_auto_insert_b.description: Auto-insert disk A into drive B when drive B is empty (helps single-sided disk games)

fast_floppy.description: Skip floppy timing emulation for instant disk access; breaks copy-protected disks

floppy_write_protection.description: Floppy write-protection: 0=off, 1=always on, 2=auto (follow host file permissions)

floppy_a_image.description: Path to a disk image to insert into drive A at startup; empty = no disk

floppy_b_image.description: Path to a disk image to insert into drive B at startup; empty = no disk

floppy_image_dir.description: Default directory shown in the floppy image file browser

use_hdd_directory.description: Expose a host directory as the Atari GEMDOS hard drive (C:)

hdd_directory.description: Host path to map as the Atari C: drive (used when use_hdd_directory is true)

use_acsi_image.description: Attach a raw ACSI hard disk image file

acsi_image_file.description: Path to the primary ACSI disk image file (used when use_acsi_image is true)

use_ide_master.description: Attach an IDE master hard disk image (Falcon/TT only)

ide_master_image.description: Path to the IDE master disk image file

use_ide_slave.description: Attach an IDE slave hard disk image (Falcon/TT only)

ide_slave_image.description: Path to the IDE slave disk image file

acsi_disks.description: Additional ACSI device slots (up to 8 total); each entry occupies one numbered slot in [Acsi]

image_file.description: Path to the disk image file for this ACSI slot

tos_image_path.description: Path to the TOS ROM image file (required; use a TOS version appropriate for the configured machine type)

cartridge_image_path.description: Path to a cartridge ROM image; empty = no cartridge

printer_enabled.description: Enable Atari parallel printer port emulation

printer_to_file.description: Redirect printer output to a file rather than a real host printer

printer_output_file.description: File path for captured printer output

rs232_out_file.description: Output device or file path for RS-232 transmitted data

rs232_in_file.description: Input device or file path for RS-232 received data

midi_in_device.description: ALSA MIDI device or file path for MIDI input

midi_out_device.description: ALSA MIDI device or file path for MIDI output

cpu_level.description: CPU model: 0=68000, 1=68010, 2=68020, 3=68030, 4=68040, 5=68060 (must be compatible with machine_type)

cpu_freq_mhz.description: CPU clock frequency in MHz (ST/STE stock=8, TT stock=32, Falcon stock=16)

compatible_cpu.description: Enable cycle-accurate CPU emulation for maximum software compatibility (reduces performance)

compatible_fpu.description: Enable cycle-accurate FPU emulation (recommended when fpu_type > 0)

blitter_enabled.description: Enable Blitter chip emulation (present on STE, TT, Falcon; optional on some early STE revisions)

dsp_type.description: DSP56001 emulation: 0=none, 1=emulated (Falcon only; required for Falcon audio and DSP software)

patch_timer_d.description: Patch Timer-D interrupt for faster emulation; may break timing-sensitive demos or software

fast_boot.description: Skip the TOS POST memory test to reduce startup time

fast_forward.description: Run emulation as fast as the host allows, ignoring real-time speed throttling

address_space_24.description: Restrict address bus to 24 bits (required for ST/STE compatibility; disable for TT/Falcon with more than 8 MB RAM)

joysticks.description: Joystick port configuration; must contain exactly 2 entries (port 0 = Atari joystick port 0, port 1 = port 1)

mode.description: Port mode: 0=disabled, 1=map a real SDL joystick, 2=emulate via keyboard cursor keys

autofire.description: Enable auto-fire for this joystick port

joy_id.description: Host SDL joystick index to use when mode=1 (0 = first joystick found)

hatari_home_dir.description: Base directory for Hatari user data (config, snapshots, captures)

hatari_data_dir.description: Directory containing Hatari system data files installed by the package

saves_dir.description: Directory for saved disk image files

captures_dir.description: Directory for audio and video capture output files
